scope: Discoverable subagent identities in 27 portfolio-role histories and the earlier audit family; excludes newly spawned census readers after the audit cutoff.
limitations: IDs are deduplicated globally. Activity events are references/interactions, not counts of independent spawns.
reportedByParentIds identifies containing history surfaces; it is not an assertion of immediate spawning ancestry.
Returned zero-turn records expose no inspectable prompts/results. They do not prove no work occurred; unexposed descendants cannot be discovered.
Readable child titles are null. Paths are supplied metadata labels, not invented task titles or original prompts.
Exhausted cursors cover returned supported summaries with bounded item text, not all raw history or unlisted project tasks.
Turn/page totals use one observed count per distinct record, not repeated tool reads. Audit child snapshots include post-cutoff turns; auditTurnsBeforeCutoff identifies the earlier work.
The metadata census contains no raw reasoning, credentials, broker-account identifiers or broker records.
An empty reportedByParentIds list means no containing-source edge was preserved in this merged metadata; it is not an assertion that the agent was unassigned.
